# `ext::sparse` — declaration reference

[All modules](../README.md) · [Source](../../../extended/ext/sparse.lani#L3)

Layer: `ext`. Role: module. Profile: **Source inventory**.

Allocation-free borrowed canonical finite binary64 CSR with full validation, row/element lookup and caller-output matvec. Strict sorted unique row columns, legal stored signed zeros and explicit shape/entry/phase-work limits. Pure matvec finite-checks all x entries before output, uses increasing-column binary64 products/additions and reports the completed-row prefix on numerical failure; output must be disjoint from every input backing. Live physical bounds/lifetimes remain manual. All six library gates and four graph-application gates pass on Linux x86_64, including a 3,886-case exact-bit model, analytic 65,536-row sparse scale case and 113 application process cases. The guide records an executed qualified-call workaround for the item-import priority dependency. No native math dependency or user-program GPU execution claim.

pub fn matvec_into(value: CsrView, x: core::slice::View<f64>, out: core::slice::View<f64>, limits: Limits)

Preflight failures write nothing and report completed=0. Nonfinite product/partial sum leaves earlier complete output rows published, failed row/suffix unchanged. Exact x/out lengths and disjoint output backing are required.
